title: Loop data of the witness geometry in a recording medium

key_results.statement: Exactly, for every $\lambda$: $|W(h_1,\dots,h_k)|^2=\prod_{j=1}^{k}W(h_j,h_{j+1})$ with $h_{k+1}:=h_1$, so the modulus of a cyclic product is pairwise data.

For a single overlap, $\operatorname{Arg}G_{hh'}(\lambda)=-\lambda\bigl(\langle K_h\rangle-\langle K_{h'}\rangle\bigr)+\lambda^2\,\omega(u_{h'},u_h)+O(\lambda^3)$; this depends on the branch-state phase convention.
For every $\lambda$, $W(h_k,\dots,h_1)=W(h_1,\dots,h_k)^*$; hence $\Phi(h_k,\dots,h_1)=-\Phi(h_1,\dots,h_k)$, exactly for small $|\lambda|$ and modulo $2\pi$ wherever $W\neq0$.
On the record space, $\omega(v,w)=g(Jv,w)$; $J$ is $g$-orthogonal, $g(Jv,Jw)=g(v,w)$, and $J^2=-\mathbb 1$.
The leading term of $\Phi(h_1,h_2,h_3;\lambda)$ saturates the bound (10.13) if and only if $u_{h_3}-u_{h_1}\in\mathbb R\,J\bigl(u_{h_2}-u_{h_1}\bigr)$ or $u_{h_2}=u_{h_1}$.
For real records ($\chi$ real, every $K_h$ real symmetric in some basis), $W(h_1,\dots,h_k;-\lambda)=W(h_1,\dots,h_k;\lambda)^*$, so $\Phi$ is odd for small $|\lambda|$ and $\Phi=O(\lambda^3)$.

In the plane example ($\chi=|0\rangle$, $K_{h_{(i,j)}}=iX+jY$), $\Phi(h_{p_1},h_{p_2},h_{p_3};\lambda)=-2\lambda^2A+O(\lambda^3)$ for every lattice triangle, where $A=\tfrac12\det(p_2-p_1,\,p_3-p_1)$ is the signed area.

In the line example ($K_{h_i}=iX$), $W(h_{i_1},\dots,h_{i_k};\lambda)=\prod_{m=1}^{k}\cos\bigl((i_m-i_{m+1})\lambda\bigr)$ with $i_{k+1}:=i_1$, so $\Phi\equiv0$ for $|\lambda|\max_m|i_m-i_{m+1}|<\pi/2$.

definitions.name: Antisymmetric form on the record space
Complex structure on the record space (multiplication by the imaginary unit)
Loop phase of a cyclic product

open_issues: The range of validity |λ| < λ₀ depends on the loop; nothing is stated at finite λ or beyond order λ², except the oddness for real records (out of scope).
For commuting but non-real records, only the λ² term is shown to vanish; whether the λ³ term vanishes is not examined.
The phase of a single overlap (10.7) is given in the branch-state phase convention of (5.5); only its cyclic sums are convention-free.

consistency_checks.check: At λ = 0 every overlap and every cyclic product equals 1 and Φ = 0, consistent with (10.3) and with (10.8), which has no λ⁰ or λ¹ term; λ times the difference of the mean records, λ²d₀², λ²ω(u, u′) and both sides of (10.13) are dimensionless.

Unit lattice triangle (0,0)→(1,0)→(0,1), exactly: W = cos²λ (cos²λ − i sin²λ), so Φ = −arctan(tan²λ) = −λ² + O(λ⁴), in agreement with (10.17) for A = 1/2 and with (10.7); |W|² equals the product of the pairwise W, as (10.3) requires.

Saturation in the plane: J acts on the lattice labels as the rotation by +π/2, so (10.14) says the triangle has a right angle at p₁, which saturates (10.13) since 2|A| = |p₂ − p₁||p₃ − p₁||sin θ₁|; the unit triangle has its right angle at (0,0) and gives |Φ| = λ² = λ²·1·1.
